reviews.text: Very good product. It controls shine really well and keeps my skin feeling smooth all day without feeling heavy. Highly recommended.
reviews.zh: 非常好嘅產品。控油效果好好，成日都令皮膚滑溜，唔會覺得厚重。極力推薦。

reviews.text: Great product! It controls shine really well and keeps my skin feeling smooth all day without feeling heavy. Highly recommended
reviews.zh: 好好嘅產品！控油效果好好，成日都令皮膚滑溜，唔會覺得厚重。極力推薦

reviews.text: good for oily skin. however, not may be not good for nose as i got a bit peel off
reviews.zh: 啱油性皮膚用。不過，對鼻頭可能唔係咁好，因為我嗰度有少少脫皮。

reviews.text: Controls oil and does not leave your skin dry at all. Leaves a satin finish thats natural
reviews.zh: 控油，皮膚完全唔會乾。會留低自然嘅絲緞光澤感。

reviews.text:
Sucks!
After putting on makeup, foundation melted off.
I even thought it was cleansing oil.
reviews.zh:
好差！
化完妝之後，粉底都溶走咗。
我甚至以為佢係卸妝油。

reviews.text: This product is extremely hard to use and the product tends to clump together so it’s hard to apply.
reviews.zh: 呢件產品好難用，而且容易結成一粒粒，所以好難搽。

reviews.text: Just a light pad onto your T-zone will instantly remove all the oil-shineness, easy to use and very light texture; does not clog up pores!!
reviews.zh: 喺T字位輕輕印一下，即刻就可以去晒油光，好易用，質地好輕盈；唔會堵塞毛孔！！

reviews.text: I think it's a very good product. I need to use it every month to soothe my skin
reviews.zh: 我覺得係一款好好嘅產品。我每個月都需要用佢嚟舒緩皮膚。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
